name: AlignmentBench
intro: Hunyuan-TurboS结果表中的“AlignmentBench”在方法段被明确写为AlignBench v1.1。本条目因此映射到AlignBench论文：通过人机协同整理683个真实场景中文查询、人工参考答案与知识型问题网页证据，并用规则校准的多维LLM裁判给出1至10分。
build_method: 真实场景查询, 人机协同整理, 人工参考答案与网页证据
task_type: 开放式问答, 对齐评测
eval_feature: 规则校准多维LLM裁判, 思维链解释, 人工参考答案
build_method_en: Real-scenario queries, human-in-the-loop curation, human references and web evidence
eval_feature_en: Rule-calibrated multidimensional LLM judge, chain-of-thought explanations, human references
intro_en: The Hunyuan-TurboS results table labels this evaluation “AlignmentBench,” while its methodology section explicitly identifies it as AlignBench v1.1. This entry therefore maps to the AlignBench paper: 683 real-scenario Chinese queries, human-verified references and web evidence, and a rule-calibrated multidimensional LLM judge scoring responses from 1 to 10.
drawio_review_note: Mapped to arXiv:2311.18743 because the Hunyuan-TurboS report labels AlignBench v1.1 as AlignmentBench. The full paper process is retained: rule-based real-scenario query curation, eight categories, GPT-4 reference drafts with human revision and web evidence, three-model difficulty filtering that removes the easier 50 percent, 683 final Chinese queries, and task-specific multidimensional 1-10 GPT-4 judging with chain-of-thought and reference score 8 as the calibration pivot.
